rationale_overall: Single-slot watchlist (cap=1) holds NVDA, the dominant exposure to the AI ride-now wave. Nvidia's Q4 FY23 results (Feb 22 2023) had CEO Huang describe AI as 'at an inflection point', and GTC 2023 (Mar 20-23) doubled down on generative-AI positioning; contemporaneous March press framed chip names as the way to play the ChatGPT/GPT-4 wave, with H100 demand climbing. Pass-1 across every other named wave found no in-window dated milestone strong enough to displace NVDA at cap=1 (tanker names gave back Jan-Feb gains by late March; broad defense-ETF launches postdate the window). Hold NVDA.
